name: Thang co
summary: A Mong stew the 2024 handbook puts on the Sunday stalls at Đắk R'Măng, with corn wine. Bao Lam Dong also names it at the Đắk Som market. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023 name thắng cố at the Đắk R'Măng market. Bao Lam Dong, 22 Sep 2023, names it as a Mong dish at Đắk R'Măng and Đắk Som.
howToEat: Neither account prints a meat, a herb list, or a simmer time for the Dak Nong pot. A method is Check on arrival.
The handbook pairs it with rượu ngô on the Sunday market. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Đắk R'Măng, Đắk R'Măng commune, Đắk Glong. The handbook says the market is Sundays. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
Bao Lam Dong also names the market at Đắk Som, Đắk Glong. A day for that market was not printed.
seoTitle: Thang co at Dak R'Mang — Sunday market stew
seoDescription: Mong thắng cố on the Sunday stalls at Đắk R'Măng, and at the Đắk Som market. A meat list and a price are Check on arrival.
